evidence.second_semantic_pass: Manual review of the compact 174-card corpus against official FIPI 2026 routes recovered five probe false negatives.

classification_policy.COVERED: The current trainer materially requires application of the exact canonical identity as a sufficiently isolated target. Mere occurrence, task-number routing or lexical coincidence is not enough.
classification_policy.PARTIALLY_COVERED: The identity is encountered only inside a mixed/composite EGE task, only some branches are exercised, or the trainer cannot diagnose this identity separately.
classification_policy.NOT_COVERED: No substantive current trainer route/card evidence requires the canonical identity.
classification_policy.probe_override: The probe produced one tentative COVERED record from a lexical-hit heuristic. It is PARTIALLY_COVERED in this audit because task 13 is composite and does not isolate the identity.

strict_next_content_step.phase_0: Split the remaining 36 NOT_COVERED identities by current EGE-2026 relevance before authoring content; do not force school-only skills into the faithful EGE trainer.
strict_next_content_step.phase_1: For proven EGE-2026 gaps, create identity-specific EGE practice content while preserving task fidelity.
strict_next_content_step.phase_2: For school/full-program gaps without a proven EGE-2026 route, create subject-level thematic/full-program practice mapped to canonical_id rather than polluting the EGE trainer.
strict_next_content_step.phase_3: For the 149 PARTIALLY_COVERED identities, add identity-specific content or mappings only where an exercise genuinely diagnoses that identity; do not relabel mixed EGE exposure as full coverage.
